description: This file defines a custom exception class `ReviewServiceException` used within the `OrangeHRM\Performance\Exception` namespace. The class provides static methods to generate specific exception instances with relevant error messages related to performance review processing in the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: ReviewServiceException
classes.description: A custom exception class extending PHP's base Exception class, with static methods to create exceptions for various error scenarios related to performance reviews.

methods.name: activateWithoutJobTitle
methods.description: Creates an instance of ReviewServiceException indicating a review cannot be activated for employees without a Job Title with KPI.

methods.name: activateWithoutKPI
methods.description: Creates an instance of ReviewServiceException indicating a review cannot be activated without KPIs.

methods.name: pastEmployeeForReviewer
methods.description: Creates an instance of ReviewServiceException indicating that a past employee cannot be added as a reviewer.

methods.name: invalidSupervisor
methods.description: Creates an instance of ReviewServiceException indicating that the selected supervisor is invalid.
